- Uses Category#replace_and_destroy!(replacement)
- Replacement must be same family and classification
- If parent has subcategories, require move first (or define cascade policy later)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { destroyed: true, reassigned_count: N } }

Errors

- validation_error (locked/default category)
- not_found (ids)
- conflict (has subcategories without policy)

Tests

- Happy: delete leaf category; delete with reassignment
- Edge: delete with children without policy rejected; wrong-family replacement rejected
